text_block_list.text:
Ugh! I couldn't win the race... I couldn't
beat
Taishin...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I was so sure I'd win! I really, really,
really wanted
to win!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Next time, at the Satsuki Sho... I'll beat
you
again.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
So you better show me a performance
that's
worth beating, just like today.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Despite her tears, Уиннинг Тикит stares

resolutely back at Нарита Таисин.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I won't lose next time! I promise!
Absolutely NOT!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
We start training for the next race, the
Satsuki
Sho, where even stronger
opponents are sure to
be.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
